title: Frenuloplasty (penile frenulum repair)
what: A small surgery: the frenulum of the foreskin is cut and stitched so it becomes longer. It is usually done with local numbing.
why: When the frenulum is short, causing pain or tears during erections and sex.
duration: surgery usually takes 20 to 40 minutes; you go home the same day
tell_doctor: If you had tears and bleeding before

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: Sometimes blood tests are needed. The clinic will give you a list.

prepare.title: Hygiene
prepare.text: Shower in the morning. Sometimes you are asked to trim the hair in the groin. Ask the clinic.

prepare.title: Clothes
prepare.text: Wear comfortable, snug underwear, so nothing moves around after surgery.

steps: You lie on the exam table
The skin is cleaned with antiseptic
A numbing injection is given at the base of the penis
The doctor cuts the frenulum and places stitches
feel: The numbing injection is unpleasant for a few seconds
During surgery, you only feel touch
When the numbing wears off, it may ache. You will get pain medicine
after: The doctor will explain how to care for the bandage and the area
Stitches usually dissolve on their own
No sex or masturbation, usually for 3 to 4 weeks. The doctor will tell you exactly
Night-time erections may be uncomfortable for the first few days. This is normal
red_flags: Bleeding that does not stop when you press on it
Severe swelling or a bluish color
A fever over 38°C or pus from the wound

faq.a: No. The foreskin is not removed. Only the frenulum is changed.
Usually not. Many men find that sex becomes more comfortable.

reminders.text: Frenulum surgery tomorrow. Bring your documents and snug underwear.
